purpose: Canonical traceability extension for infrastructure adapters and operator verification scripts. PostgreSQL remains authoritative and the merged tenant/RLS controls remain unchanged.
rules: Infrastructure adapters are additive derived-service boundaries; they do not replace canonical PostgreSQL state.
Neo4j projection operations require explicit tenant scope and must be rebuildable from canonical PostgreSQL rows.
Object-storage writes are immutable by default and file uploads must stream rather than read complete files into memory.
Managed-service production rollout remains HOLD until separately verified with deployment-specific credentials and evidence.

code_module_records.schema: projection_id is tenant scope plus canonical UUID; graph rows remain authoritative in PostgreSQL
code_module_records.state_machine: explicit tenant scope -> constrained trusted worker database read -> tenant-only canonical graph rows -> tenant-only Neo4j replacement -> success/fail closed
acceptance_criteria: tenant projection rebuild cannot delete another tenant projection
node replacement removes stale properties
logical edge endpoint changes remove the previous projected relationship before recreation
rebuild reads canonical graph rows only for the explicitly selected tenant
canonical Postgres store remains unchanged by projection wiring
code_module_records.source_preservation: preserved; Neo4j remains derived and rebuildable and does not become a canonical write authority
unresolved_gaps: managed Neo4j production verification remains HOLD

code_module_records.schema: content digest metadata plus content-addressed default keys and conditional write-once object creation
code_module_records.state_machine: resolve standard or explicit credentials -> hash input -> conditional If-None-Match write -> identical digest idempotence or conflicting overwrite rejection
acceptance_criteria: standard boto3 credential provider chain is supported
temporary session tokens are supported
file uploads stream from a file handle
different content cannot overwrite an existing immutable key
code_module_records.source_preservation: preserved; object storage is additive and does not replace governed database provenance
unresolved_gaps: production bucket policy and managed credential verification remain HOLD

code_module_records.schema: Temporal address, namespace, optional API key/TLS and existing trusted worker database identity
code_module_records.state_machine: verify trusted worker database topology -> construct authenticated Temporal client -> start/reuse workflow -> run worker
acceptance_criteria: Temporal Cloud API key is passed through the SDK client
API-key mode requires TLS
existing BRAIN_WORKER_DATABASE_URL and trusted-service RLS checks remain intact
code_module_records.source_preservation: preserved; only Temporal transport authentication is extended and existing tenant/RLS worker authorization remains authoritative
unresolved_gaps: live Temporal Cloud verification remains HOLD

code_module_records.schema: configured/ok/error result per PostgreSQL, Neo4j, Temporal and S3-compatible object storage dependency
code_module_records.state_machine: discover configured dependency -> connect with native authenticated client -> native health/read operation -> aggregate configured-service health -> zero/nonzero CLI result
acceptance_criteria: health checks use native service clients
configured unhealthy services fail aggregate health
missing optional service configuration is reported without fabricating connectivity
code_module_records.source_preservation: preserved; health inspection is read-only and additive
unresolved_gaps: live managed-service health evidence remains HOLD

code_module_records.owner_object: The right to run the cognition loop against one canonical database
code_module_records.schema: PostgreSQL session-level advisory lock on a fixed key, held for the lifetime of a dedicated connection
code_module_records.state_machine: request lease -> granted: tick cognition until yield interval or connection loss -> release -> re-request; denied: retry on an interval without ticking
acceptance_criteria: at most one process per database drives cognition
a dead holder's lock is released by Postgres without operator action
a worker that cannot take the lease waits rather than double-writing
the API stops ticking the moment it loses the lease
the API yields periodically so a dedicated worker takes over without a restart
code_module_records.source_preservation: preserved; the two-process API/worker split is unchanged and the worker remains the intended cognition host. In-process cognition is a fallback for deployments that have no worker, not a replacement for one.
unresolved_gaps: live evidence of a worker taking the lease from a running API remains HOLD until a worker service exists
the API's inline loop does not run connector ingest or prediction-expiry maintenance, which remain worker-only
